strings.name: Philippe Aghion
strings.summary: Born in Paris, Aghion studied mathematics and mathematical economics before a Harvard doctorate. With Peter Howitt he developed a creative-destruction growth model linking innovation, technological replacement and long-run growth. He studies competition, education, industrial policy and green transition. After teaching across Europe and America, he shared the 2025 economics Nobel with Howitt and Mokyr.
